down.n: Cecil, Dark Knight // Cecil, Redeemed Paladin

30.brief: Only 1 big event ran in the last 30 days, so these shares rest on few decks. Dimir Midrange led it at 18%, and Azorius Artifacts jumped to 10%. Erode is now in 30% of decks.

Dimir Midrange leads Standard at 13%, up 2.9 pts. Orzhov Lifegain gained the most, rising to 8.2%, while Izzet Elementals dropped 7.2 pts. Erode moved into 26% of decks and Duress into 44% of sideboards.

bans.brief: After the Aug 10 bans, Dimir Midrange rose from 0.6% to 11%, the biggest gain. Mono-Green Landfall grew to 18% of top finishes despite losing Badgermole Cub. Izzet Prowess turned to Burst Lightning, now in 55% of its lists.
